audit_items.proof_trace: The guild membership check (fetchMemberStatus → is_in_server) was deliberately commented out in auth/callback/route.ts (L105-119, marked '一時的にコメントアウト') and is never re-checked in completeRegistration; the substitute only verifies that a member.members record exists (admin whitelist), not active guild membership. The generation_role requirement has no enforcement mechanism anywhere in the registration flow — fetchMemberStatus's role data is never consulted, and no role check appears in completeRegistration, the auth callback, or any upstream gate.
audit_items.attack_scenario: A user previously added to member.members by an admin (or one who left the Discord guild after being whitelisted) can scan a Kiosk QR code and call completeRegistration to link a card without satisfying guild membership or generation role requirements; the absence of any role check means even a user with the wrong (or no) generation role completes registration.
